collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The leader's decision to plant in the wrong season ruined the crop: demand they step down, or help them fix it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The {@chief} insisted the village plant early this year, against the farmers' advice, and a late storm destroyed everything. (subject) is furious and wants the {@chief} to step down. (friend) points out that everyone makes mistakes, even chiefs. What should the village do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) raises it at the gathering. The {@chief} listens, then stands and says (other.he/she) was wrong, and that the farmers should decide planting from now on. (other.He/she) does not step down. The village accepts this, narrowly.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village replants together, {@chief} included, digging in the mud beside everyone else. It is a hungry season. The {@chief} never decides the planting again. (subject) is still angry, but helps.
